newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks jump 1,600-point mark at noon.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks jump 1,600-point mark at noon.

text.p: Pakistan stocks rebounded at noon on Wednesday to hurdle the 1,600-point barrier as select blue chips rose on fresh buying. Dealers said the index would rise further in the near term.
"Buying in telecom utility PTCL and Hub Power pushed up the index," dealer Ambreen Shaukat said. "Karachi Electric Supply Corporation gained on news it would be privatised this year."
The index rose 7.62 points, or 0.48 percent, to 1,600.48 at midday. Losers led gainers 138 to 53. PTCL rose 0.25 rupees to 31.95 and Hub Power 0.25 to 42.40.
